newspaper.headline: Shop App Hit Errors After Release
newspaper.lead: Last Thursday's release briefly broke the shop app's payment page. The developer team now requires tests for every new piece of logic before release.

impact.good: Yesterday, the faulty release was rolled back quickly and users were barely affected. Healthy releases kept running.
impact.mixed: Yesterday, some release problems were handled, but one rollback was late or unnecessary. The team is reviewing how it reads error numbers.
impact.bad: Yesterday, the faulty release stayed live too long. Many users couldn't pay in the shop app.

tip.title: Tip: Think of the Weird Cases
tip.text: Before submitting, imagine strange input: an empty list, zero, capital letters. Edge-case tests catch bugs before users do.

newspaper.classified: LOST: One test for an empty list. Last seen before Thursday's release.
